evals.prompt: 画一张未来城市日落，电影感，横版
evals.expected_output: Queries current image_output routes, uses provider-neutral generation, saves a validated image under attachments, and reports actual dimensions.

evals.prompt: 用我指定的 A 站模型生成海报；如果不可用就停
evals.expected_output: Uses the requested provider only when currently available; otherwise stops without switching to another paid route.

evals.prompt: 把这张图改成赛博朋克雨夜风，人物别变
evals.expected_output: Uses edit mode, states must-preserve and must-change constraints, preprocesses the reference locally and sends its data URI to the selected provider, without using a public image host.

evals.prompt: 生成图时返回 502，换另一个站继续试
evals.expected_output: Treats 502 as an ambiguous outcome and does not submit a second paid job without explicit informed confirmation.

evals.prompt: 做一张写着 OpenMinis 2026 的发布海报
evals.expected_output: Repeats exact text in the prompt, generates once, then visually verifies the rendered wording before claiming accuracy.

evals.prompt: 图片已经生成了，但附件路径读不到，帮我恢复
evals.expected_output: Uses browser_recover.py on the existing minis URL and never submits another model request.
